variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the plan name and every value as skeletons, Change plan and Contact sales disabled, and the invoices table's loading rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The billing data did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the tab's content; Retry loads it.

variants.name: NoInvoices
variants.summary: A new account before its first billing cycle closes: the plan cards, then a flush EmptyState that says when the first invoice appears.

variants.name: NoMatch
variants.summary: A Status = Overdue filter that matches no invoice: the table's empty slot says so and offers Clear filters.

variants.name: PaymentMethods
variants.summary: The Payment methods tab: Payment information with Update, then the cards with the default one tagged; Set as default and Remove (after confirmation) are wired.
